_comment: Declared required status-check contexts per protected branch. This file is the local, zero-outbound source of truth for scripts/check_required_check_coverage.py, which asserts that every context listed here is produced by a workflow that triggers UNCONDITIONALLY on a pull request into that branch. Refresh it by hand from `python scripts/check_required_check_coverage.py --sync`, which prints the live state via the user's own `gh` CLI and never writes. Rationale and the vendor citation live in the module docstring of that script.
